title: Fall Bird Walk
description:
Join Jenny at the Dunning branch for a morning bird walk at the Dunning Read Natural Area (Park 601). We will be joined by Matt at DNRA and Robyn from the Chicago Ornithological Society. We’ll try to spot raptors, woodpeckers, kinglets, creepers, sparrows, rabbits, squirrels, and the resident coyote. Binoculars will be provided.
We will meet next to the sign for the DNRA parking lot. 


Accessibility
Need sign language interpretation or other accessibility assistance for this event? Please call (312) 747-8184 or email access@chipublib.org to request accommodations. Requests must be made at least 14 business days before the event.

title: Family Field Trip to Brookfield Zoo
description:
Join us on the bus to spend the day at Brookfield Zoo. 

General admission to the zoo is free.  

The Nature Express Bus program is provided by the Forest Preserves of Cook County.

title: Tot Play Time
description:
Join us for a new Saturday play time for children ages 0-4 years old. Babies and toddlers will have fun, educational toys to choose from while older kids can play with Duplo blocks, magnetic tiles, puzzles and pretend play toys. No registration is required. This is a 5-week series of play.

For ages 0 to 5.

title: Saturday Game Day
description:
Join us every Saturday for Saturday Game Day. This is a drop-in program. Bring a game or play one of ours: UNO, Skip-bo, Mexican Train, Canasta, Chess, Checkers, Sorry and more! Players gather on adult side of building as space allows. No registration is needed. Make new friends!
